```{r}
library(tidyverse)

(Nataf_butterfly_data_2020==NA) = 0

combined_data <- left_join(names_combined,Nataf_butterfly_data_2020)

names20 = Nataf_butterfly_data_2020$`Scientific Name`

names21 = Nataf_butterfly_data_2021$`Scientific Name`

names_combined = union(names20,names21)

finaldata=data.frame(names_combined)

finaldata<-finaldata %>% rename("Species" = "Scientific Name")

finaldata=left_join(finaldata,Nataf_butterfly_data_2021)

df2 <- data.frame(t(finaldata[-1]))
colnames(df2) <- finaldata[, 1]

final_wide = df2

final_wide[is.na(final_wide)]=0

write.csv(final_wide,"~/אוניברסיטה/שנה ג/אקולוגיה של חברות/Data 20-21 final.csv")

```

```{r}
species19 = Nataf_by_site_2019$Species
species20 = Nataf_by_site_2020$Species
species21 = Nataf_by_site_2021$Species

allspecies = union(species19,species20)

allspecies = union(allspecies,species21)

finaldata = data.frame(allspecies)

colnames(Nataf_by_site_2021) <- paste(colnames(Nataf_by_site_2021),"2021",sep=" ")

colnames(Nataf_by_site_2021)[1]="allspecies"

finaldata=left_join(finaldata,Nataf_by_site_2021)

finaldata[is.na(finaldata)]=0

finaldata<-finaldata %>% rename("Species" = "allspecies")

write.csv(finaldata,"~/אוניברסיטה/שנה ג/אקולוגיה של חברות/Nataf by site long.csv")

df2 <- data.frame(t(finaldata[-1]))
colnames(df2) <- finaldata[, 1]


write.csv(df2,"~/אוניברסיטה/שנה ג/אקולוגיה של חברות/Nataf by site wide.csv")
```
